differences.what: the camera: no pinhole camera draws this engraving within about 2 m (the solve says why), so its render is not the engraving's view; the front's length, the walls' height, the corner's cut and the conservatory's place are judged on the two photographs' views (chicagology_923_photo, daily_news_dn0003324), where T-3271 builds them to Hunt's plan
the south flank's first window column behind the canted corner: its chamber window carries an iron balcony on consoles, as the front's do; the render's has none
the basement lights: the engraving draws them round-headed, under the front and the conservatory; the render's are square-headed
the conservatory's curved glass roof with an iron-railed deck at the chamber floor, and its tall barred lights on a stone base
the stoop between stone cheeks before the door, the iron cresting, the dormers: drawn as the photographs show them; a tree in leaf hides the front's middle and most of the mansard
the fence: the engraving's is the scroll-pattern fence of 1893 or before; the 1904 fence is judged on the Daily News view
the brick's colour: the picture is monochrome
the north flank, the rear and the rear ranges: out of the picture's sight

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236). A ticket whose ## Image gate names this building does not close while it is not "matches" (tools/image_gate.mjs).
